title: Genomic and structural insights into TATA-Binding protein from cestodes.
authors: Landa, Abraham; Heredia-Gomez, Elisa; Gonzalez-Kulikova, Cristina; Velazquez-Villegas, Laura A; Rodriguez-Lima, Oscar
one_liner_zh: 该文对绦虫TATA结合蛋白(TBP)进行基因组与结构分析，通过同源建模、蛋白-DNA对接和MD模拟揭示TBP1/TBP2与TATA盒结合的保守机制，属于TF-DNA互作的结构与动态建模研究，高度契合本课题。
abstract: The TATA-binding protein (TBP) is an essential component of the eukaryotic transcriptional machinery, yet little is known about the structure, evolution, and functional divergence of TBP paralogs in parasitic flatworms. Here, we performed a comprehensive comparative analysis of TBP1 and TBP2 across cestode species of medical and veterinary relevance. Using genomic annotation, multiple sequence alignment, homology modeling, phylogenetics, electrostatic potential mapping, and protein - DNA docking complemented with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, we reveal that both paralogs maintain a highly conserved genomic organization and the canonical TBP alpha/beta saddle architecture. TBP1 exhibits moderate variability in sequence and electrostatic in peripheral regions, whereas TBP2 is more conserved, suggesting distinct evolutionary constraints. Despite paralog divergence, all cestode TBPs retain the key aromatic and basic residues required for minor-groove recognition of the TATA box and interaction with general transcription factors. Docking and MD simulations confirm a conserved pattern of TATA-binding across species, with TBP2 displaying exceptionally uniform interaction networks. Together, these findings provide genomic and structural data for TBPs in cestodes, suggesting the existence of paralog-specific regulatory roles and offering new insights into transcriptional control in parasitic flatworms.
abstract_zh: TATA结合蛋白（TATA-binding protein, TBP）是真核转录机制的核心组分，然而关于寄生扁虫中TBP旁系同源物的结构、进化和功能分化知之甚少。本研究对具有医学和兽医重要性的绦虫物种中的TBP1和TBP2进行了全面的比较分析。利用基因组注释、多序列比对、同源建模、系统发育学、静电势映射以及蛋白质-DNA对接，并结合分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，我们揭示这两种旁系同源物均保持高度保守的基因组组织及典型的TBP α/β鞍形结构。TBP1在外围区域表现出适度的序列和静电变异性，而TBP2更为保守，提示其受到不同的进化约束。尽管旁系同源物存在分化，所有绦虫TBP均保留了对TATA盒小沟识别及与通用转录因子相互作用所必需的关键芳香族和碱性残基。对接和MD模拟确认了跨物种的TATA结合保守模式，其中TBP2展现出异常均匀的相互作用网络。综合来看，这些发现为绦虫TBP提供了基因组和结构数据，提示存在旁系同源物特异的调控作用，并为寄生扁虫的转录调控提供了新见解。
